notes: Mid-market product analytics vendor building an in-app product partner (PM assistant + release-note summarization). Started with Hosted API PoC; after successful proof-of-concept they requested Dedicated (VPC) for tenant isolation and predictable latency. Security review escalated: SecOps requires SOC2 Type II report, SAML SSO integration pattern, audit log retention policy, and keys in customer-managed KMS. Product team: latency target p50 <= 150ms for short form chat, p95 <= 350ms; throughput ~25-40 concurrent chat sessions (burst to 100). Cost sensitivity: wants to keep inference spend within $150k ARR equivalent; will evaluate batching/quantization proposals from Redwood Optimize. SE ran a 2-week POC with 5k test tokens/day; metrics: 120ms p50 on hosted for small model, but need consistent P95 on Dedicated. Legal requested sample DPA and data residency language for EU customers. CSM not assigned until procurement. Quote requested for 3 deployment variants: Dedicated single-tenant pool (preferred), Dedicated with shared pool + tenancy controls, and hybrid (hosted fallback).
